mentions.text:
I asked OpenAI Astra Ultra + Anthropic Fable 5.1 Max to make me a 5x-10x return type portfolio in 1 year. 

Burnt a lot of credits, and the results are in: 

OpenAI: - $KYTX (autoimmune CAR-T results)
- $PRQR (human RNA-editing datasets)
- $VSTM (KRAS cancer-drug)
- $CNTB (asthma and COPD)
- $RANI (oral biologics)
- $IVA (MASH)
- $SILC (networking + inference hardware)
- $AMPX (batteries)
- $EOSE (batteries)
- $ZVRA (rare-disease drug growth)

Anthropic: - $INO (respiratory papillomatosis)
- $CAPR (PDUFA for deramiocel)
- $GOSS (seralutinib)
- $SLS (Phase 3 binary)
- $IREN (familiar face)
- $WULF (familiar face)
- $OKLO (nuclear)
- $SMR (nuclear)
- $RGTI (quantum)
- $QBTS (quantum)

*Disclosure don't own any of these aside from 1 share in IREN, not a recommendation, just TLDR of LLM output for educational purposes. 

So very interesting results:

Our beloved AGI Astra prefers really obscure biotech I've never heard about. And a few familiar names like $EOSE and $AMPX. 

And Fable... yeah idk, feels like it learned a little too much from /r/wallstreetbets and X but maybe it's right, who knows.  

Anyway no judgement, I'll save this and revisit it in a few months. If one of them actually delivers... I'll be impressed.
